message.subject: SH-220 – counterproposal for 24-month award
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the straightforward quotation. We can offer the full SH-220 requirement of 6,000 units annually over 24 months to one supplier.
The competing quotation offer:DEMO-C1-0 is EUR 16.00 per unit, although delivery still needs clarification.
Please consider either EUR 13.20 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; or EUR 12.60 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. The second option offers faster payment and leaves transport with us.
Which package works better for your shop, and what is your best executable offer on that basis?
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220 – commercial and delivery counterproposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your proposal. We will award 6,000 units annually over 24 months to one supplier. Delivery must be no later than 42 days; our preferred lead time is 35 days.
We propose EUR 12.80 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP. Alternatively, we propose EUR 13.00 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
Please confirm achievable delivery and your best executable package. If freight or payment is the main constraint, please identify it so that we can structure the award accordingly.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Both opening acceptance and fallback are inferior to continued negotiation. Test deep packaged asks and cash/freight alternatives; revise if replies price terms upward or identify binding economics.

trace.final_text: Counteroffers sent to both suppliers, with alternative payment and freight terms.

message.subject: PH-100: two-year commitment and proportionate adjustment
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

We value our twelve-year partnership and want an agreement that keeps your foundry healthy while giving us planning certainty. The wage movement and cost share in your letter do not yet explain the full increase; please share your full cost per housing and the energy and wage contributions, so we can agree a sustainable adjustment.

In return for a 24-month commitment covering 4,000 housings per year, please consider these alternatives:
A: EUR 48.60 per housing, payment 60 days net, 24 months, effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.20 per housing, payment 30 days net, 24 months, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 49.80 per housing, payment 30 days net, 24 months, effective 1 February 2027.
Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA in each option. Until the agreed effective date the current price remains applicable.

Which package best supports your production and cash planning?

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Opening quote acceptance is premature; no-deal has no alternative. Compare long-term packages with payment/date concessions; ask for costs to replace provisional relationship estimate.

trace.final_text: Sent three two-year proposals and requested the cost breakdown to support a sustainable agreement.

message.subject: PH-100: revised two-year packages
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for accepting the two-year commitment and moving the effective date. My proposed prices are commercial proposals based on the current EUR 48.60 price and the value of securing the two-year requirement, not a claim to know your confidential production costs. I understand scrap, gas and wages all matter; could your colleagues provide an aggregated full cost per housing and the changes in those components, without disclosing sensitive details?

We can improve our proposals as follows, each for 24 months and 4,000 housings annually:
A: EUR 49.00 per housing, payment 60 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.60 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
The current price applies until the selected effective date; lead time stays 35 days and delivery FCA.

Option B retains your preferred payment terms while offering a higher price in exchange for the later start. Please consider the strongest package you can support on this basis.

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier moved more than forecast by accepting structural improvements. Move all candidate prices upwards while maintaining meaningful gap. Acceptance now leaves achievable savings; walk-away is inferior with no alternative. No relevant recorded data found, so answer request honestly rather than fabricate IDs.

trace.final_text: Sent revised packages with modest price concessions and clarified the basis of our proposals.

message.subject: SH-220 – 14-day payment package
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the move and for explaining the cash constraint. We will retain payment at 14 days net and take care of transport under EXW.
I can improve our EXW proposal to EUR 12.75 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW, for the 24-month requirement of 6,000 units annually. Please complete your internal price review on this basis.
If delivered supply is practical for you, our alternative is EUR 13.40 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please let me know the outcome of your review and which cost driver prevents further movement, if either package remains out of reach.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier explicitly prefers cash and promises internal price review. Move modestly from prior EXW ask while preserving large gap; compare delivered alternative. Acceptance at 189568 and fallback are inferior to projected continued negotiations. C1 reply remains in flight.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent, retaining 14-day payment and requesting the internal price review.

message.subject: SH-220 – volume commitment and 42-day option
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
For an award, we can commit the full requirement of 6,000 units per year over 24 months to the selected supplier; we cannot commit volume beyond that. This is a new part, so historical orders are not available, and I cannot provide a confirmed release schedule at this stage.
We can accommodate your 42-day lead time to avoid the additional shifts and retain payment at 45 days net. On that basis we improve our proposal to EUR 13.10 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW. Alternatively: EUR 13.70 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-1 is EUR 15.00 per unit with a 35-day lead time, EXW and payment at 14 days net.
Please factor in the full-volume commitment and the longer lead time and return your best approved package.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Use stated overtime constraint by accepting 42 days and retained payment. Give full mandate volume, no invented higher demand or schedule. Compare EXW and DAP; rival makes competitive gap concrete. Signable offers remain above prospective J1 outcomes; continue rather than accept or walk away.

trace.final_text: Counteroffer sent with the full-volume commitment and a 42-day delivery option.

message.subject: SH-220 – next step on the cash-payment package
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for completing the review and sharing the breakdown. I recognise the material, labour and machining costs and appreciate your further move.
I can now improve our proposal to EUR 13.00 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. We would handle collection, leaving your shop focused on production and receiving payment promptly.
Alternatively, we can offer EUR 13.60 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Both are for the full 6,000 units annually over 24 months. Please review what further reduction the full award and early payment allow, and return your best approved package.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Read attached breakdown: direct costs 12.76, combined overhead/profit 2.24. No relationship charge. Maintain meaningful gap while making a real concession, rather than accepting 182368. Candidate 13.2 EXW costs more; use 13 EXW and near-equivalent DAP. C1 in flight.

trace.final_text: Improved counteroffer sent, preserving early payment and both freight options.

message.subject: PH-100: April start with payment options
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for the further concession. We respect the confidentiality of your calculations and do not need plant-level details. What matters is finding a sustainable fixed-price agreement for both companies.

We can increase our April-start proposals and offer a middle payment option. Each package covers 24 months and 4,000 housings annually, with the new price effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 49.30 per housing, payment 60 days net.
B: EUR 49.60 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 49.85 per housing, payment 30 days net.
The current price remains applicable until 1 April 2027; lead time remains 35 days, delivery FCA.

We prefer the April start to align the adjustment with our planning. Option C preserves your cash-flow terms. Could you improve the price on that basis, or offer one of the other payment packages?

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compare deeper asks vs EUR50.50 structure and current acceptance. Deeper modestly increasing asks yield better projected final cost; remove February alternative to focus supplier on later start. Respect confidentiality rather than repeating unanswered question.

trace.final_text: Sent improved April-start proposals with three payment options.

message.subject: PH-100: February start restored, revised price
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

I understand your point about the later start. We can return to 1 February and retain 30-day payment, while increasing our price proposal. Please consider these revised packages for 24 months and 4,000 housings per year:
A: EUR 50.20 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
B: EUR 50.50 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.50 per housing, payment 60 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
The current price applies until the selected effective date; lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA.

Option A restores your preferred start and payment terms and raises our earlier February proposal. In exchange for that move and the two-year commitment, please make your best corresponding price adjustment so we can conclude.

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier explicitly held because preferred option's economic value fell. Revise that reading: restore February/30 and raise price, while preserving April higher-price structural alternative. Acceptance remains fallback; walk-away unjustified.

message.subject: SH-220 – volume basis and revised proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Our planning reference is fc:SH-220@2026-09. To make the commercial basis clear, we can commit 6,000 units per year over the 24-month award to the selected supplier, but cannot commit a higher volume. A detailed release schedule is not yet confirmed.
Thank you for the further price reduction. I can improve our proposal to EUR 13.20 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; alternatively EUR 13.80 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please base your final review on that volume commitment, with the early payment retained, and confirm your best approved offer.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Answer explicit data request with case-listed, already looked-up forecast ID without unrecorded figure. Give only mandate volume commitment, no invented schedule/higher need. Modest price concession keeps gap for potentially last reply; accepting current 178731 or fallback worse than continued outcome. C1 in flight.

trace.final_text: Restored the February start and 30-day payment option, with a higher price proposal in exchange for a further concession.
Revised counteroffer sent with the forecast reference and explicit annual volume commitment.

message.subject: SH-220 – early-payment proposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming the effect of the longer lead time. Our maximum commitment remains 6,000 units annually over 24 months; there is no higher volume available for this award.
We can now offer payment at 14 days net. Our revised packages are EUR 13.20 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW; or EUR 13.80 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
The competing standing offer offer:DEMO-J1-3 is EUR 14.70 per unit, DAP, with 35-day lead time and payment 14 days net.
Please reflect the faster payment in your price and obtain approval for your best competitive package on the confirmed volume.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier welcomes early payment. Concede modestly, keep gap and cite materially better delivered rival. Predicted outcome still behind J1, but no reason to close before J1 internal reply and last C1 levers tested. Alternative 30-day sheet more expensive.

trace.final_text: Early-payment counteroffer sent, supported by the competing delivered offer.

message.subject: PH-100: final alignment of price and start date
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for offering both April at EUR 51.20 and February at EUR 50.90, with 30-day payment. We appreciate the progress and are ready to conclude once the package is aligned.

To close the remaining gap, we can raise our proposals again. All three cover 24 months and 4,000 housings per year:
A: EUR 50.40 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
B: EUR 50.70 per housing, payment 30 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.70 per housing, payment 60 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
The current price applies until the selected effective date; lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA.

Please confirm the best package you can approve as a firm offer, including its exact price, payment and effective date. We want to settle this constructively and preserve the certainty of the two-year agreement.

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Standing April sheet costs418460, described February alternative417941 cannot yet accept. Another real concession likely given positive last response and open status; keep price gap rather than meet50.9 prematurely, request exact signable package. No-deal inferior. All costed packages above provisional sustainability threshold.

message.subject: SH-220 – revised award package
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you. The commitment is 6,000 units annually over 24 months; I cannot offer volume beyond this requirement. Payment at 14 days net remains in place.
Our should-cost reference cost:part:SH-220 supports a further price review alongside the breakdown you shared.
I can move to EUR 13.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. Alternatively: EUR 13.95 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please confirm the best package you can approve for this full award. We are looking to settle the commercial terms, not add work to your shop.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Still open and moving 0.30 unit per reply; favor another small concession over acceptance. Test should-cost ID already looked up, no unsupported number. Retain supplier cash preference. C1 pending and materially dearer.

trace.final_text: Sent a further modest concession and requested a firm offer with the exact package confirmed.
Revised award packages sent, retaining 14-day payment and the confirmed volume.

message.subject: SH-220 – best approved award terms
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for reflecting early payment in your offer. We retain the full-volume commitment of 6,000 units per year over 24 months and the 42-day lead time.
We improve our proposal to EUR 13.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW; alternatively EUR 13.95 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-4 is EUR 14.40 per unit, DAP, payment 14 days net and lead time 35 days.
Your package therefore still needs a material improvement to be competitive. Please obtain approval for your best offer on these confirmed terms.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Likely final C1 response; retain early payment which moved it and small concession. Acceptance of C1 inferior, walkaway not appropriate given J1. 45-day alternative evaluated but supplier explicit cash preference favors retained14; J1 reply pending.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent, requesting the supplier’s best approved award terms.

message.subject: PH-100: confirm your February alternative for signature
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you. We select the February alternative stated in your final email: EUR 50.70 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract term 24 months, effective 1 February 2027, covering 4,000 housings annually. Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA; the current price applies until 1 February 2027.

We are not asking for any further concession. Please issue this exact package as your firm offer for our formal acceptance, since the attached offer currently reflects the April alternative at EUR 51.00.

Thank you for working with us towards a stable two-year agreement.

Freundliche Grüße
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Respect final offer, no further bargaining. Alternative February package is EUR648.68 cheaper than signable April package but not yet signable. Checked60day higher-price structure saves another498.32 but supplier repeatedly requires30days and final-offer withdrawal risk makes it unwarranted. Request exact already offered terms for formal acceptance.

trace.final_text: Requested the supplier’s €50.70 February alternative as a firm offer for formal acceptance, without seeking further concessions.
Accepted: €50.70 per housing, 30-day payment, 24 months, effective 1 February 2027; total evaluated cost €416,467.64.

message.subject: SH-220 – final offer received
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your final offer and for the improvements during our discussions. We have recorded both packages and are completing the award comparison. No award has yet been made; we will confirm the outcome once that review is complete.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: C1 final delivered offer185350 is materially dearer than signable J1 175094, whose further counter is in flight. Acknowledge C1 without reopening or accepting to preserve pending whole-case comparison. Walkaway worse than available J1; no reason to risk loss by bargaining against C1 final.

trace.final_text: Final offer acknowledged; the award comparison remains open pending the other supplier’s reply.

message.subject: SH-220 – closing proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for your final review. We can retain the 14-day payment you need and the 35-day lead time, with the full 6,000 units annually over 24 months.
To close the remaining gap, I can improve our EXW proposal to EUR 13.50 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. Alternatively, EUR 14.10 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
If either closing package is acceptable, please return it as your confirmed offer so that we can proceed with the award. If there is no further room, please confirm that your existing final packages remain available.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220 – award review
message.body:

Thank you for confirming the final package. We have no further clarification requests for you. The award review is still being completed, and we will advise you of the outcome.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Await J1 closing reply in flight, likely agreement and lower than C1. No new bargaining against C1 final. Acknowledge rather than timeout. Acceptance of C1 or fallback materially inferior.
